clauses.scope_note: Sections H.1–H.3: Customer's use of the Services. Fees are for amounts incurred by Customer's account at the published Model Pricing Page rates unless the parties agree otherwise; rates may be updated on the stated notice schedule. The clause also addresses prepayment credits, taxes, withholding, and gross-up payments. Nonpayment when due may result in suspension or termination; this is a stated consequence, not a separate Customer duty.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed predicates describe payment and tax duties attached to Customer's use. Supplemental Credits Terms apply only to credits; the supplied material does not include those terms. Applicable tax and withholding duties depend on the relevant facts and law.

obligation_items.content: Pay fees incurred by Customer's account at the rates specified on the Model Pricing Page, unless otherwise agreed by the parties.
obligation_items.object: Fees for Services incurred by Customer's account
obligation_items.trigger: Fees are incurred by Customer's account and are due.

obligation_items.content: Remit necessary withholding Taxes to the relevant authority on a timely basis and provide Anthropic evidence of remittance upon request.
obligation_items.object: Withholding Taxes and evidence of their remittance
obligation_items.trigger: Withholding Taxes are necessary; evidence is owed when Anthropic requests it.

obligation_items.content: Pay Anthropic the Gross-up Payment sufficient to ensure Anthropic receives the amount it would have received absent the required withholding or reduction, taking applicable Taxes on the Gross-up Payment into account.
obligation_items.trigger: A withholding or reduction by Customer is required.

obligation_items.content: Comply with Anthropic's Supplemental Credits Terms.
obligation_items.trigger: Customer uses credits; the incorporated Supplemental Credits Terms are not supplied.

clauses.scope_note: Section I.2 gives each party a convenience termination right by Notice, with Anthropic required to provide 30 days' prior Notice; either party may terminate for the other party's material breach by 30 days' prior Notice detailing the breach unless cured within that period; Anthropic may terminate immediately with Notice if it reasonably believes or determines providing Services to Customer is prohibited by applicable law. These procedural termination rights do not themselves specify a Customer activity beyond the resulting access boundary.
clauses.condition_explanation: terms_not_terminated means the Terms remain in effect. The termination notice, breach, cure, and applicable-law conditions govern the parties' termination rights, not an independent licensee permission.

clauses.scope_note: Sections I.3–I.4: Anthropic may suspend access on the specified security, policy/use-restriction, legal, material-cost, or third-party-vendor grounds. Upon termination, Customer may no longer access the Services. This rule captures the resulting access boundary; the suspension and termination procedures themselves are not customer conduct permissions.
clauses.condition_explanation: anthropic_suspends_customer_access means Anthropic has suspended access under I.3.a, including a suspension resulting from a vendor suspending or terminating a required third-party service or product. terms_terminated means the Terms have terminated. A suspension ends when its triggering event is cured, where curable, and Anthropic resumes access; no access prohibition is asserted after resumption unless the Terms have terminated.

obligation_items.content: Do not access or use the Services while Customer's access is suspended or after termination of the Terms.
obligation_items.trigger: Anthropic has suspended Customer's access, or the Terms have terminated.

coverage_notes: The Model Pricing Page, Supplemental Credits Terms, and incorporated policies or service terms are not supplied; their contents are not inferred.

The suspension provision includes Anthropic's reasonable-efforts notice and resumption duties, and the termination section includes notice and cure procedures. Those actor-specific procedural duties do not map faithfully to the allowed activities and are identified as unresolved in the audit.

The dispute-resolution paragraphs contain operative duties and procedures that cannot be faithfully represented with the allowed activities; they are identified as unresolved below. Venue and arbitration forum details are not modeled as activity constraints.

paragraph_audit.reason: Sections H.1–H.3 impose account-fee and tax payment duties, provide for credits and rate updates, and state consequences of failure to pay; the behavioral payment duties are captured as conditions on Customer's use.

The clauses capture termination-triggered and suspension-triggered access restrictions, but the notice, breach-cure, suspension-notice, and resumption procedures impose operative duties or rights that do not map faithfully to the allowed activities.

The paragraph imposes operative dispute-notice, good-faith informal-resolution, and timely-response duties and provides for arbitration and equitable relief. These procedural duties and mechanisms cannot be faithfully represented using the allowed activities.
